title: 概念编辑时间步课程学习

standard.summary: 概念编辑训练中把 timestep 采样限制在一个逐步轮换的窄 band 内，按「由易到难」的课程顺序覆盖整个时间步区间。默认关闭（保持全窗口均匀采样）。
standard.effect: 开启后每一步只从当前 band 采样 timestep，band 随步数循环推进；关闭时在 [min_timestep, max_timestep) 内均匀采样，行为不变。
standard.whenToUse: iLECO/ADDifT 训练不稳定、loss 在不同 timestep 区间震荡剧烈时；步数较多（≥300）足够完成多个 band 循环的任务。
standard.avoidWhen: 极短训练（几十步）时 band 覆盖不完整、部分时间步学不到；已经手动收窄 min/max_timestep 到很小区间时课程化意义不大。

standard_en.summary: Confines timestep sampling in concept-edit training to a narrow band that rotates step by step, covering the whole timestep range in curriculum order from easy to hard. Off by default (uniform sampling over the full window).
standard_en.effect: Once on, each step samples its timestep only from the current band, and the band advances cyclically with the step count; off, sampling stays uniform over [min_timestep, max_timestep) and nothing changes.
standard_en.whenToUse: When iLECO/ADDifT training is unstable and the loss swings sharply between timestep ranges, and the run is long enough (>=300 steps) to complete several band cycles.
standard_en.avoidWhen: In a very short run (a few dozen steps) the bands are not fully covered and some timesteps never get trained; and there is little point once you have narrowed min/max_timestep to a small range by hand.

advanced.principle: 不同 timestep 对应不同学习难度与内容（高噪声学结构、低噪声学细节），全窗口随机采样使梯度方向在难度间跳变。band 课程把每步的监督集中在窄区间内，降低批间梯度方差，循环推进保证最终覆盖完整窗口。
advanced.intervention: concept_edit_curriculum.py：读取开关与 concept_edit_timestep_curriculum_buckets（band 数，默认 10，非整数时告警回落）；concept_edit_anima_timestep.py 在采样 timestep 时把均匀抽样限制到当前 band。
advanced.expectedImpact: loss 曲线更平滑、概念编辑方向更一致；同等步数下每个 timestep 区间的有效步数不变，只是重新排序。
advanced.tradeoffs: band 轮换引入训练进程的周期性（loss 有锯齿是正常现象）；与手动 min/max_timestep 组合时 band 在收窄后的窗口内划分。
advanced.codePath: concept_edit_curriculum.py：开关与 band 解析；concept_edit_anima_timestep.py：band 内受限采样；configs_anima.py 定义

advanced_en.principle: Different timesteps carry different difficulty and content (high noise learns structure, low noise learns detail); random sampling over the full window makes gradient directions jump between difficulties. A band curriculum concentrates each step's supervision in a narrow interval, lowering inter-batch gradient variance, while cyclic progression guarantees the full window is eventually covered.
advanced_en.intervention: concept_edit_curriculum.py: reads the switch and concept_edit_timestep_curriculum_buckets (band count, default 10, warning-and-fallback on non-integers); concept_edit_anima_timestep.py restricts uniform timestep sampling to the current band.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Smoother loss curve and more consistent concept-edit direction; per-interval effective steps per total step count are unchanged, merely reordered.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Band rotation introduces periodicity into training progress (a sawtooth loss is normal); combined with manual min/max_timestep, bands are divided within the narrowed window.
advanced_en.codePath: concept_edit_curriculum.py: switch and band parsing; concept_edit_anima_timestep.py: band-restricted sampling; defined in configs_anima.py
